verdict.rationale: In-product AI insights are a fair question for a payments and POS product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no AI-generated insights or suggestions inside SumUp itself. The MCP server and Agent Toolkit only let external AI clients and developer-built agents call SumUp APIs, which are building blocks rather than in-product insights. 'Automated marketing' is an adjacent feature and does not count as AI-generated data insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
